message.content:
Build a LAPTOP-INDEPENDENT server-side nightly scanner for /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 + Prisma). It runs on the Proxmox host via a systemd timer, gathers real signals, and writes deduped proposals into the `Improvement` table (the admin Improvements board) — so the board fills up even when the owner's laptop is off. Do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma (the `Improvement` model exists: id, batchId, category, severity, title, summary, detail?, source?, effort?, filesHint?, status default PROPOSED, resolvedNote?, timestamps). Do NOT run git. Read `scripts/write-improvement.ts` and `lib/actions-improvements.ts` first to match the model/fields exactly.

Build:
1. **`scripts/nightly-scan.ts`** — a tsx-runnable script (`async function main(){...}; main().catch(...)` — NO top-level await; the runner is cjs). It:
   - Gathers heuristic signals (all read-only, all wrapped in try/catch so one failure never aborts the run):
     a. **Server errors**: run `journalctl -u nxeon-web -u nxeon-worker --since "24 hours ago" -p err --no-pager` via `node:child_process execFileSync` (or spawn), cluster identical/similar lines, count occurrences; propose the top few recurring ones (category "error", severity by frequency).
     b. **Failed jobs**: `db.job` where status='FAILED' and updatedAt within 24h — group by type, propose if any (category "bug").
     c. **Failed emails**: `db.emailLog` where status='FAILED' in 24h — propose (category "bug", include the error).
     d. **Stuck jobs**: `db.job` RUNNING for > ~30 min — propose (category "error").
     e. **New feedback / bug-flagged tickets**: recent `db.feedback` rows (status NEW) and any support tickets flagged as bugs — propose a review item (category "feature"/"bug").
     f. **Open abuse alerts** count > 0 — propose (category "security").
   - **Dedup**: before creating, load existing improvements with status in (PROPOSED, APPROVED, IN_PROGRESS) and skip any whose title matches (case-insensitive, trimmed) — never repropose.
   - Writes via `db.improvement.create(...)` directly (don't shell out to write-improvement.ts). Stamp `source:"nightly-scan"`, `batchId` = today's date (compute from `new Date()` — this runs at runtime, fine), keep `summary` to ONE concise sentence.
   - Logs a one-line summary: `[nightly-scan] wrote N proposals (batchId=...)`. Idempotent enough to run daily.
2. **`deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.service`** and **`deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.timer`** — systemd oneshot service (WorkingDirectory /opt/nxeon, EnvironmentFile /opt/nxeon/.env, User=nxeon, ExecStart `/usr/bin/npx tsx scripts/nightly-scan.ts`) + a timer firing daily at ~03:30 with `Persistent=true` (so a missed run catches up). Write both to `deploy/` for the parent to install.
3. A short `deploy/NIGHTLY-SCAN-README.md` with the two `systemctl` commands to install+enable the timer.

Constraints: no new npm deps. The script must run cleanly: test it with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx scripts/nightly-scan.ts` — it should complete without throwing and print its summary line (it's fine if it writes 0 proposals on a healthy system). Verify `npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` stays clean. Report the signals implemented, the files created, and the smoke-test output.

#!/bin/bash
# Create an in-app notification for all admins (used by systemd OnFailure= hooks).
# Usage: alert-admins.sh "Title" "Body"
cd /opt/nxeon
set -a; . ./.env; set +a
TITLE="${1:-Nxeon alert}"; BODY="${2:-A background job failed.}"
node -e '
const { PrismaClient } = require("@prisma/client");
const db = new PrismaClient();
db.user.findMany({ where: { role: "ADMIN" } }).then(async admins => {
  await db.notification.createMany({ data: admins.map(a => ({ userId: a.id, title: process.argv[1], body: process.argv[2], href: "/admin" })) });
  await db.$disconnect();
}).catch(()=>process.exit(0));
' "$TITLE" "$BODY" 2>/dev/null || true

# Nxeon nightly scanner

Server-side, laptop-independent scan that runs on the Proxmox host and writes
deduped proposals into the `Improvement` table (admin Improvements board). It
gathers read-only signals — recurring server-log errors, failed jobs, failed
emails, stuck jobs, new feedback, bug-flagged tickets, and open abuse alerts —
and never reproposes a finding that is already active on the board.

## Install + enable the timer

```bash
# Copy the units into place
sudo cp /opt/nxeon/deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.service /etc/systemd/system/
sudo cp /opt/nxeon/deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.timer   /etc/systemd/system/

# Reload systemd and enable the daily timer (fires ~03:30, catches up if missed)
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now nxeon-nightly-scan.timer
```

## Verify / operate

```bash
# See when it will next run
systemctl list-timers nxeon-nightly-scan.timer

# Run it once right now (writes real proposals)
sudo systemctl start nxeon-nightly-scan.service

# Inspect the last run's output
journalctl -u nxeon-nightly-scan.service --no-pager -n 20
```

The service runs as `User=nxeon` with `EnvironmentFile=/opt/nxeon/.env`. It is a
`oneshot` unit driven entirely by the timer — enabling the timer is all that is
needed. Reading the service journals uses the `systemd-journal` supplementary
group; if the `nxeon` user is not in that group the log-error collector simply
returns nothing (the rest of the scan still runs).

## Summary

Built a laptop-independent, server-side nightly scanner for `/opt/nxeon`. Read `scripts/write-improvement.ts` and `lib/actions-improvements.ts` first, then matched the `Improvement` model exactly by inspecting `prisma/schema.prisma`. Did not touch the schema or run git.

### Files created
- `/opt/nxeon/scripts/nightly-scan.ts` — tsx-runnable, `main().catch(...)` pattern, no top-level await, writes via `db.improvement.create` directly.
- `/opt/nxeon/deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.service` — oneshot, `User=nxeon`, `WorkingDirectory=/opt/nxeon`, `EnvironmentFile=/opt/nxeon/.env`, `ExecStart=/usr/bin/npx tsx scripts/nightly-scan.ts`.
- `/opt/nxeon/deploy/nxeon-nightly-scan.timer` — daily `OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:30:00`, `Persistent=true` (missed runs catch up), 300s jitter.
- `/opt/nxeon/deploy/NIGHTLY-SCAN-README.md` — the two `systemctl` install/enable commands plus verify/operate commands.

### Signals implemented (all read-only, each in its own try/catch so one failure never aborts the run)
- **a. Server errors** — `journalctl -u nxeon-web -u nxeon-worker --since "24 hours ago" -p err --no-pager` via `execFileSync`; strips syslog prefix, normalizes volatile tokens (numbers/hex/UUIDs), clusters similar lines, proposes the top 3 recurring (≥2 occurrences) as category `error`, severity by frequency.
- **b. Failed jobs** — `db.job` `status=FAILED` in 24h, `groupBy` type, category `bug`, with latest error in detail.
- **c. Failed emails** — `db.emailLog` `status=FAILED` in 24h (`createdAt`), category `bug`, latest error in detail.
- **d. Stuck jobs** — `db.job` `RUNNING` with `updatedAt` older than 30 min, category `error`.
- **e. New feedback + bug tickets** — `db.feedback` `status=NEW` in 24h (category `bug`/`feature` by kind); open `db.ticket` with bug/error/broken in subject (category `bug`).
- **f. Open abuse alerts** — `db.abuseAlert` `status=OPEN` count > 0, category `security`.

### Key design points
- **Dedup**: loads active improvements (`PROPOSED|APPROVED|IN_PROGRESS`) and skips any case-insensitive/trimmed title match; also dedups within a single run. All titles are deliberately stable (counts/dates live in `summary`/`detail`, never the title) so a finding is never reproposed while still open.
- Stamps `source:"nightly-scan"`, `batchId` = today's local date, one-sentence summaries, `status:"PROPOSED"`.
- Logs `[nightly-scan] wrote N proposals (batchId=...)`.
